description: RedERP is an all-in-one cloud ERP for small and medium-sized businesses: sales and invoicing, procurement, inventory and warehouses, accounting and treasury, point of sale, e-commerce, CRM, human resources, manufacturing, project management and more, in one multi-company, multi-branch platform available in English, French and Arabic. This plugin brings your RedERP company into ChatGPT so you can work with your business data in plain language instead of navigating screens. Ask who your clients are and what they owe, check a product's price and stock per warehouse, review quotations, sales orders, delivery notes, invoices, credit notes and return notes, follow client payments and account statements, or get the sales KPIs of the current fiscal year. Act on it too: create clients, draft quotations, orders, delivery notes and invoices with their line items, move documents forward in their workflow, convert a quotation into an order or an invoice, and record client payments allocated to invoices. Every document comes with a download link to the same PDF RedERP prints (logo, taxes, totals in words, QR code, digital signature) that you can share with a customer in seconds. This first version covers the RedERP Sales module end to end; additional RedERP modules will be added in future versions. Everything runs with your own RedERP login and role: data stays limited to your company and branches, nothing is ever deleted, cancelled or overwritten from ChatGPT, and every PDF link expires automatically. RedERP is built by Red Digital Factory — https://rederp.ai — documentation: https://docs.rederp.pro/en/docs/mcp
